 Druski to host Saturday Night Live this weekend
 Nov 04, 2026 
 Copy link 
 Copy link 
 YouTube superstar Druski is heading to television’s biggest live stage this weekend.
 Watch him host Saturday Night Live on NBC November 7th at 11:30 p.m. ET (8:30 p.m. PT).
 With over 6 million subscribers, nearly 2 billion views and 220 million watch time hours across his channel, Druski has kept his fans laughing on YouTube for years. From hilarious sketches to his hit shows Could Been Records Auditions & Coulda Been Love, he’s now bringing his signature comedy directly to SNL leading the creator-driven momentum that’s redefining what entertainment looks like today.
 After the show, tune into the official Saturday Night Live YouTube channel to catch the monologue, standout sketches, and best moments from the night.
